fact.claim: Each Site-to-Site VPN connection has two tunnels, and a standard VPN tunnel supports up to 140,000 packets per second (the VPN FAQ states this value for each tunnel; the quotas page gives it for a standard tunnel).
fact.question: What is the approximate maximum packets per second of a Site-to-Site VPN tunnel, according to the VPN FAQ?

values.spoken: up to one hundred forty thousand packets per second

qualifiers.scope: per standard VPN tunnel; a connection has two tunnels

evidence.quote: Each AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection has two tunnels and each tunnel supports a maximum packets per second of up to 140,000.
evidence.title: AWS VPN | FAQs | Amazon Web Services (AWS)

evidence.quote: | Maximum packets per second (PPS) per standard VPN tunnel | Up to 140,000 | No |
evidence.title: AWS Site-to-Site VPN quotas

fact.note: FAQ question: 'What is the approximate maximum packets per second of a Site-to-Site VPN connection?' (item 19).
fact.author: mine-12-faq

votes.reason: The quote states two tunnels per connection, each up to 140,000 packets per second.

Since large bandwidth tunnels (2025-09-25, 2025-11-12) a tunnel can support up to 400,000 PPS (vpn-limits, large bandwidth tunnel row); the unscoped claim of up to 140,000 per tunnel holds for standard tunnels only.
